description: Connect your ProSocial People Skills Index profile so ChatGPT and Codex can tailor collaboration, communication guidance, and interpersonal coaching to your measured, trainable skills. You can also share an approved AI Writing Fingerprint to help draft text in your writing style. Each resource has its own sharing control in ProSocial. Both tools are read-only: they do not change your profile or read source emails, writing samples, or Dale conversations. Turning sharing off blocks future reads but does not remove data already used in a host conversation or memory.

defaultPrompt: Use my ProSocial profile to tailor how we work together.
Prepare me to disagree with my manager tomorrow using my measured people skills.
Draft a follow-up after a tense team meeting, matched to my profile.
